cohort: The study included thirteen full-term infants with moderate/severe neonatal encephalopathy, eleven with perinatal stress, and twelve control infants.
finding: Increased brain injury biomarkers were followed by upregulation of SDF-1 receptor and erythropoietin, and subsequently by elevated circulating progenitor cells, suggesting a potential endogenous regenerative effort, primarily in moderate encephalopathy but suppressed in severe cases.
cross-section timing: Blood samples were collected on days 1, 3, 9, 18, and 45, as well as at 8 and 24 months of life.
